sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Duty AB onboard the ship underway, noticed a skiff approaching from the aft of the ship. Alarm raised, crew alerted, and all deck lights switched on, resulting in the skiff moving away. The incident was reported to the Singapore VTIS and authorities.
